source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the advantages of monoclonal antibodies (PDF 212-213).

blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies zaati (personalised) ilaaj ka markaz hain jo har mareez ke mutabiq ilaaj mumkin banati hain. Un ke design aur tayyari mein musalsal jiddat ilaaj ko zyada mo'assar aur har mareez ki hayatiyat ke mutabiq banane ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.caption: Monoclonal antibodies ke fawaid (kitab ki fehrist)
rows: riwayati dawaon ke muqable mein, lambe asar ke imkaan ke saath
har aik sirf aik target se jurti, kam farq ke saath
Nishana bandi wala cancer ka ilaaj
kitab ke mutabiq tehqeeq ke liye tayyar karna aasan
doosri dawaon ke saath rad-e-amal ka kam khatra

blocks.text: Kitab mazeed kehti hai ke jadeed technologies hazaron mumkina antibodies ki aik saath jaanch mumkin banati hain, jis se tayyari ka waqt kam aur muta'addi bimariyon aur cancer jaise fori masail ka tez jawab mumkin hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Cancer ke ilaaj mein monoclonal antibodies sehatmand tissue ko kam nuqsan kyun deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sirf cancer cells par apne makhsoos target antigen se jurti hain, aam chemotherapy ke bar-aks jo normal taqseem hone wale cells ko bhi nuqsan deti hai.

items: Fawaid: kam zehreela pan, kam zimni asraat, zyada makhsoosiyat, nishana bandi wala cancer ilaaj, tehqeeq, kam rad-e-amal.
